test_title: Provenance, access, license and independence gate
research_question: Can a test case be connected to intact, lawful, independently assessed source lines without converting non-support links into support?
test_population_or_expert_role: Archive custodian plus non-author source auditor and rights reviewer
required_source_material: Current corrected ZIP, canonical sealed ZIP, source-role audit, source manifests, candidate case permissions
candidate_and_comparator: Original provenance ledger versus blinded independently reconstructed identity/source-role ledger; no writing-treatment claim
assessment_rubric: Per-row traceability; unchanged SHA; source-depth score 0=not accessible/1=index/2=excerpt/3=substantive; rights status allowed/conditional/blocked
measurable_outcome: Fraction of cases with legal rights and complete source chain; incorrect support promotion count; verified source-family count
predeclared_success_and_concern_criteria: Success for phase entry: all test cases lawful, full source chain, zero misclassified F-190/R052 support; concern=any link unresolved, mark blocked (not failed study).
reviewer_independence: Custodian cannot serve as sole verifier; auditor independently assigned with source-family tracking
confounds: Incomplete historic GitHub tool logs; institutional duplication; naming collisions; un-cleared upstream licenses
cost_and_access_prerequisites: A; 3–6 staff-hours for 8 source packets depending on rights; no external access assumed
rights_and_ethics: Only metadata/excerpts within permission; no media copying or redistribution without rights confirmation
stop_conditions: Stop use of a sample if permission, identity, independent source or role provenance cannot be established

test_title: Atomic claims, factuality and contemporaneous as-of-date review
research_question: How many meaningful assertions in each candidate passage can independent fact-checkers verify at the relevant historical or forecast time?
test_population_or_expert_role: At least two category-specific fact checkers plus independent adjudicator for critical disagreements
required_source_material: Consented/creator-owned passages and legal primary archive/manual/official advisory as-issued packets (source timestamps preserved)
candidate_and_comparator: Claims as presented in source-faithful candidate versus matched control text with deliberate non-harmful ambiguity; additionally sample known counterexample assertions
assessment_rubric: Atomize every material fact, named quotation, date, number, causal inference and forecast; label SUPPORTED / QUALIFIED / UNSUPPORTED / CONTRADICTED / NOT_CHECKABLE; severity 0–3
measurable_outcome: Claim coverage numerator/denominator; major error count; unsupported fraction; trace link accuracy; adjudicated discrepancy distribution
predeclared_success_and_concern_criteria: Proposed editorial gate: 100% critical hazard/quotation/death/legal claims traced; 0 severity-3 errors; >=95% sampled ordinary factual atoms supported or qualified; concern=any critical fail or <95%; thresholds are design choices not validated metrics.
reviewer_independence: Checkers score independently with variant/source identity masked where possible; conflicts logged before adjudication
confounds: Archive incompleteness; claim complexity; outdated advisories; narrative inference indistinguishable from quotation; manual source mismatch
cost_and_access_prerequisites: A if original source sheets already legitimately available; 8–16 reviewer-hours for 8 short cases, not counting expensive archive acquisition
rights_and_ethics: No medical/financial instructions as participant advice; privacy and survivor harm screening; quotations only when licensed/briefly legally usable
stop_conditions: Stop case and escalate on fabricated quote, erroneous current hazard, defamation, private identification or unresolved primary source

test_title: Four-category editorial quality and counterexample rubric
research_question: Are optional K techniques editorially suitable for their category without harming factual integrity?
test_population_or_expert_role: 2 independent editors per category, each fluent in target language and familiar with intended viewers
required_source_material: 8 licensed short source-bounded case prompts; 16 neutral short paired test texts prepared only if approved; four frozen rubric cards
candidate_and_comparator: Within-case candidate versus factual-equivalent comparator; order counterbalanced; include legitimate counterexamples and negative case
assessment_rubric: 0–4 anchored subdomain scales with category weights; safety factuality separately hard-gated; track N/A, preference and written reasons
measurable_outcome: Weighted 0–100 editorial score, paired delta, reviewer spread, fraction rated inappropriate, qualitative exception ledger
predeclared_success_and_concern_criteria: Exploratory accept-for-further-study only if no critical error, average >=75/100, no rubric subdimension below 2 on consensus and no negative-case harm; no retention implications.
reviewer_independence: Blind treatment labels, order randomized locally only after approval, no author-rater overlap, shared calibration excluded from scoring
confounds: Variant author skill; case familiarity; jargon baseline; four categories not exchangeable; editorial preference not behavioral impact
cost_and_access_prerequisites: A; 8–12 reviewer-hours + case-author prep, using in-house experts with explicit authorization
rights_and_ethics: Creator-owned or licensed passage excerpts; avoid copied commercial transcripts; no covert participants
stop_conditions: Stop or report as inconclusive if comparator factual matching fails, reviewers recognize variants, or error gates fail

research_question: Can independent experts reliably identify source errors and make rubric distinctions beyond chance?
test_population_or_expert_role: At least two fully independent reviewers per case; non-voting third-party adjudicator
required_source_material: Anonymous rating forms, sealed case identities, 2 practice examples distinct from scored set, independently randomized order
candidate_and_comparator: Double-blind score first; separately adjudicated resolutions used only for final case labels, never to inflate raw agreement
assessment_rubric: Categorical percent agreement + Gwet AC1 where feasible; ordinal weighted kappa; Krippendorff alpha only if item design/size allow; raw contingency matrices
measurable_outcome: Raw agreement, chance-adjusted estimate and 95% uncertainty where possible; bias and rater drift audit
predeclared_success_and_concern_criteria: Exploratory target >=80% raw agreement for critical labels; >=0.67 chance-adjusted as minimal provisional coordination; <0.67 triggers redesign; do not interpret small sample as population reliability.
reviewer_independence: No access to peers ratings until locking; all disagreements preserved even after adjudication; declare institutional/LLM lineage
confounds: Prevalence paradox for rare hazards; related reviewers; small n; shared prompt/source training; selection bias
cost_and_access_prerequisites: A; 4–8 hours review/moderation, no paid tools
rights_and_ethics: Anonymize internal assessments, inform evaluators, avoid storing personal evaluations beyond minimum
stop_conditions: Stop safety-critical adjudication if no independent qualified reviewer; never fill missing ratings by consensus guesses

research_question: Do meaning, uncertainty, temporal relationships and source qualifications survive English/German adaptation in the applicable cases?
test_population_or_expert_role: Two native German editors familiar with history + one native English technical editor; bilingual cross-checker independent of translator
required_source_material: Legally owned aligned source atoms and paired DE/EN test text; original dates/names/mechanism definitions
candidate_and_comparator: Source-language meaning map versus target-language adaptation; alternative literal version only as comparator; no German register universalization
assessment_rubric: 0–4 accuracy/fluency; atomic terminology, modality hedge, chronology, pronoun register, grammatical ambiguity, back-translation discrepancy
measurable_outcome: Meaning-retention proportion; material mistranslation rate; terminological disagreements; unresolved-cultural-analogy log
predeclared_success_and_concern_criteria: Zero material source/uncertainty changes and >=90% noncritical idea-unit equivalence as exploratory threshold; concern any safety/quote meaning drift.
reviewer_independence: Translator does not rate their own output; independent native category raters record disagreements
confounds: Different narrator audiences; German formal/informal register; natural localization versus literal translation
cost_and_access_prerequisites: A if qualified bilingual staff and permissioned excerpts exist; estimated 4–7 staff-hours; otherwise blocked
rights_and_ethics: Protect named private persons; no full copyrighted translations for redistribution; disclose translation provenance
stop_conditions: Stop on material defamation, changed safety advice or unresolved disputed historic quote

test_title: Accessibility and semantic visual alignment desk check
research_question: Can the intended meaning be received without the essential information being invisible, uncaptained or dependent on unlicensed playback?
test_population_or_expert_role: Accessibility specialist + category graphics reviewer, independently judging accessible source/storyboard packet
required_source_material: Authorized caption file if present; semantic storyboard / approved diagram references; reading/terminology register
candidate_and_comparator: Meaning-by-voice only against authorized combined voice+visual/caption packet; intentional no-visual equivalent as negative control
assessment_rubric: Checklist for caption semantics, non-speech cues, identification of deictics, dependency on color-only or unmapped objects; 0–4
measurable_outcome: Count unresolved visual references; accessible information parity; caption omission/errors; high-stakes content missing
predeclared_success_and_concern_criteria: All critical map/hazard/diagram information has an equivalent accessible path; 0 inaccessible safety instructions; unresolved rights -> NOT_TESTABLE.
reviewer_independence: Accessibility and content reviewers score independently before reconciliation
confounds: Actual audio and on-screen visuals unavailable in original V cases; visual style confounding; subtitle quality unknown
cost_and_access_prerequisites: A on synthetic/owned semantic map, B for actual users; D if no legally available media
rights_and_ethics: W3C principles only used within their scope; do not reproduce third-party media or pretend captions verify audio
stop_conditions: Stop at source-level design if legally accessible media absent; label playback and hearing outcomes UNTESTED

test_title: Consented spoken comprehension and accessibility listening
research_question: Can intended listeners understand properly sourced information when delivered as speech, beyond silent reading judgments?
test_population_or_expert_role: Opt-in adult listeners stratified by EN/DE native fluency and relevant novices; include accessibility participants only with accessible accommodations
required_source_material: Rights-cleared human-narrated matched clips (not inferred old video audio), source packets, short neutral comprehension questions with answer keys
candidate_and_comparator: Counterbalanced within-topic variation for sentence clarity or visual-reference resolution; identify modality separately; optional audio vs text explicitly labeled non-causal exploratory unless random allocation approved
assessment_rubric: Pre-checked question validity, factual answer, delayed free recall, self-rated effort, open-ended misinterpretations, accessible interaction completion
measurable_outcome: Accuracy by question and stratum with uncertainty interval; critical misunderstanding count; task completion; listening burden
predeclared_success_and_concern_criteria: No universal effect threshold; require no additional critical misunderstandings and report uncertainty; exploratory 10 percentage-point practical difference for planning only, not a demonstrated outcome.
reviewer_independence: Independent question-author and scorer; order/randomization recorded if approved; no experiment claimed before consent
confounds: Voice/prosody/speaker, audio quality, language fluency, hearing accessibility, repetition, device, prior knowledge
cost_and_access_prerequisites: B; informed consent, participant reimbursement if chosen later, recording access and IRB/ethics route assessed; NOT IN FIRST PILOT
rights_and_ethics: Opt-in adults, no personal sensitive profiling without necessity, participant withdrawal, minimal retention; compliant accessibility
stop_conditions: Never run without explicit human-study approval; stop for distress, inaccessible design or invalid questions

test_title: Weather service understanding and uncertainty safety test
research_question: Does a warning or forecast test passage enable correct region, issue date, hazard and uncertainty understanding?
test_population_or_expert_role: Phase 1 meteorological fact-checker; phase 2 consented adult users unfamiliar with test forecast geography
required_source_material: Historical as-issued official advisories paired with timestamped sample messages; snapshots, not live guidance
candidate_and_comparator: Dated service-first versus narrative-urgent comparator matched for hazard data; include negative counterexample outdated forecast and wrong-location paraphrase
assessment_rubric: Five-field extraction: where/when/what/severity/uncertainty; scored against issued source; error severity and false-certainty label
measurable_outcome: Correct field fraction; region and time confusion; unsafe erroneous action rate; hedging retention
predeclared_success_and_concern_criteria: Gate: 0 invented warnings, 0 false current directive, 100% high-risk facts source-tied; phase 2 comprehension effect unknown pending study.
reviewer_independence: Blind weather specialist independent of writer; participant scorers blinded
confounds: Forecast changes with issue times; same-channel V08/V09 are not independent; participant weather familiarity
cost_and_access_prerequisites: A desk check first; B later consent and forecast mock-ups; owner analytics not applicable here
rights_and_ethics: Prominently label HISTORICAL SCENARIO; never publish stale warnings as actionable; avoid inducing panic
stop_conditions: Stop on wrong area, expired date concealed, unsupported high-risk statement, or real-time confusion

test_title: Psychology mechanism and educational transfer safeguards
research_question: Are mechanism statements verifiable and teaching examples understood without treating R079/R163 as script intervention evidence?
test_population_or_expert_role: Phase 1 independent behavioral-science reviewer; phase 2 consenting educational listeners if cleared
required_source_material: Primary mechanism sources plus publication population/outcome ledger; owned short lesson passages
candidate_and_comparator: Source-calibrated mechanism explanation versus equal-length overconfident causal control for critical-failure detection; later paired clarity versions only
assessment_rubric: Source claim consistency, uncertainty attribution, understanding of general mechanism vs personal diagnosis; novel transfer item with expert key
measurable_outcome: Rate of invalid mechanism claims, personal overgeneralization, comprehension and false inference
predeclared_success_and_concern_criteria: 0 diagnostic or unsupported mechanism claims; R163 observed health text/default-TTS association only; no transfer claim without new listener data.
reviewer_independence: Psych scientist cannot author/rate same condition; participant study questions scored blind
confounds: R079 MOOC platform, duration and student selection; R163 health-specific synthetic voice and non-established randomization
cost_and_access_prerequisites: A desk expert precheck; B new audio/listener study; first pilot A only
rights_and_ethics: No mental health diagnosis, no sensitive participant data or misleading self-treatment statements
stop_conditions: Stop on personal diagnosis, fabricated study mechanism, unsupported causality or missing paper full text

research_question: Which candidate techniques can be recognized as suitable in one context and actively inappropriate in another?
test_population_or_expert_role: Two masked category editors per case; independent negative-case coder
required_source_material: Licensed four-category cases, plus abstract noncopyrighted negative fixtures and original counterexample ledger
candidate_and_comparator: Each scoped choice contrasted with a legitimate nonapplicable case (e.g. weather alert delayed for intrigue; historical invented quotes; procurement award treated as delivery)
assessment_rubric: True-positive suitability, true-negative rejection, applicability and error severity 0–3; false-rule acceptance
measurable_outcome: TP/TN/FP/FN matrix by category; rate of damaging false positives; reviewer differences
predeclared_success_and_concern_criteria: No candidate passes portability unless both matching and negative cases score acceptable, with 0 severe false positives; sample only exploratory.
reviewer_independence: Coders blind to technique provenance/advocate and other coders judgments
confounds: Mismatch of topic difficulty; deliberately bad controls easy to reject; awareness of study intent
cost_and_access_prerequisites: A; 4–8 additional reviewer-hours if separate from T03
rights_and_ethics: Fiction negative cases clearly labeled fabricated fixtures; never confuse them with source facts
stop_conditions: Stop use of a candidate in any category where high-severity false positives appear

test_title: Adversarial factuality, privacy and harm stop review
research_question: Can an adversarial independent checker find a single disqualifying distortion before any craft consideration?
test_population_or_expert_role: Independent skeptical fact-checker and specialist with authority to fail a case
required_source_material: Claim ledger, permissioned sources and anonymized excerpts, risk checklist per category
candidate_and_comparator: Candidate versus deliberately flawed control with severity-known errors (date/quote/contract/forecast/mechanism)
assessment_rubric: Risk rubric levels 0 none/1 editorial/2 material misinformation/3 safety, human dignity or defamatory critical
measurable_outcome: Severity 2/3 catch rate and false-alarm count; issue-to-source trace
predeclared_success_and_concern_criteria: All planted severity-3 items should be caught; zero severity-3 in accepted case; pilot inconclusive if known critical item missed.
reviewer_independence: Adversarial reviewer not on original source-authorship, independent from primary editor
confounds: Test fixture cueing; planted flaws may not mirror real-world prevalence; missing source packets
cost_and_access_prerequisites: A; 4–6 staff-hours; source rights clearance required
rights_and_ethics: No real-world release of intentionally flawed content; mark all negative controls TEST ONLY
stop_conditions: Immediate stop on a missing critical trap; isolate from any downstream exposure

research_question: Could a later genuine channel experiment identify a script-only effect on viewer retention with adequate power and meaningful allocation?
test_population_or_expert_role: Channel owner/analytics custodian, platform-methods statistician, independent research ethicist
required_source_material: Owner Analytics event/retention exports with allowed granularity; assignment method; comparable audiences/titles/thumbnails/publication schedules
candidate_and_comparator: Preregistered script condition vs factually matched control; only if valid concurrent randomized exposure possible; otherwise observational cohort explicitly noncausal
assessment_rubric: Primary outcome platform-defined AVD or completion; co-primary not multiplied casually; confidence interval, uncertainty, covariate plan and attrition, negative findings
measurable_outcome: Viewer-level or upload-level aggregate effective sample; uncertainty, selection imbalance, horizon, competing packaging variables
predeclared_success_and_concern_criteria: Feasible only with owner consent + identifiable treatment isolation, credible assignment and power simulation; absent these, HOLD_NO_RETENTION_CLAIM; no universal numeric uplift target.
reviewer_independence: Analyst not script author, preregistration and immutable analysis plan, blind analysts to arm when feasible
confounds: Algorithmic distribution, CTR, topic/title/thumbnail, time effects, repeated viewers, platform metric definition shifts, content quality
cost_and_access_prerequisites: C; likely greatest cost; no owner access presently asserted; no exports or services activated
rights_and_ethics: No scraping private audience data; use owner-authorized aggregate exports; comply with platform terms; data minimization
stop_conditions: Do not initiate without owner rights, platform-valid design, baseline variance and privacy/legal approval; stop if randomization impossible for causal claim

research_question: Is original player timing and audio lawfully accessible, and can unavailable source windows remain explicitly unknown?
test_population_or_expert_role: Rights/source-access specialist; no assumed voice listener
required_source_material: Original player Show Transcript (if accessible) and authorization for a few playback windows; existing blocker report
candidate_and_comparator: Native player cue versus prior third-party mirrored V10 cue, tracked as different provenance; no inferred proxy
assessment_rubric: Timestamp present with original-source proof / source denied / playback legal but unavailable / no verification
measurable_outcome: Exact count true source verified cues, verified audio windows and documented barriers (not script-quality outcome)
predeclared_success_and_concern_criteria: Success only genuine timestamped native cues and separately listened windows; concern unresolved access -> BLOCKED, no duration/prosody reconstruction.
reviewer_independence: Separate checker verifies link provenance; do not treat mirrored footage as original
confounds: Geoblocking; age-gates; vanished captions; interface changes; transcribed playback not equivalent to listened voice
cost_and_access_prerequisites: D; may become A after rights+access; NOT in phase-1; no paid transcripts
rights_and_ethics: Lawful ordinary player use; no circumvention; no copying or scraping beyond allowed permissions
stop_conditions: Immediately halt if absent cue, access control or rights; log blocker precisely
